summary: Iteration 38 full verification of vendor payout runs, individual settlement payment, monthly commission invoices, vendor scorecards, the city-guide form editor and the vendor portal additions. Backend: 79/79 pytest pass = 60 regression (test_iteration35_nav_banking, test_iteration35_sitemap_policies, test_iteration36_bank_docs_city, test_iteration37_doc_review) + 19 NEW in test_iteration38_payouts.py covering: batch creation groups a vendor's pending settlements into ONE batch (settlements flip to 'batched' with batch_id) while a payout_hold vendor is returned in 'skipped' and left pending; GET /admin/vendor-settlements items+vendor info+totals(due/batched/paid/commission/platform_fee)+held count and no _id leakage; GET /admin/vendor-payout-runs list + open/paid totals; CSV export (text/csv, attachment, beneficiary name/account/IFSC/amount/reference, 404 on unknown batch); POST .../paid rejects blank UTR (400), marks batch + all its settlements paid with the UTR, notifies the vendor ('Settlement transferred' notification asserted in Mongo) and rejects a second attempt (400); individual POST /admin/vendor-settlements/{sid}/paid refuses a held vendor (400 'on hold'), requires UTR (400), pays and rejects a repeat (400), 404 unknown; commission invoice generation for 2026-06 created exactly one invoice per vendor with settlements, numbered BUD-CI-2026-06-0001/0002, total = commission+platform_fee (300+150=450), IDEMPOTENT on a second call (same ids, no new rows), admin list, vendor-only /vendor/commission-invoices, PDF 200/%PDF for owning vendor AND admin, 403 for a different member, 404 unknown; POST /api/cron/commission-invoices 401 without the WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET bearer and 200 with it; scorecards 0-100 with cancel_rate/rating/complaints/documents_complete/payout_hold, correct green>=80/amber>=60/red thresholds, sorted worst-first, vendors:view enforced and NO status change (flag only); RBAC 401 anon and 403 member on all four admin reads plus the batch write. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL, admin+partner logins): sidebar 'Vendor settlements' ([data-testid=admin-tab-vendorpay]) opens vendor-payouts-panel with 4 KPI cards, the payout-hold note and all four tabs; 'Run payout batch' created 1 batch and toasted both success and 'TEST_ UI Held Vendor: bank verification pending'; Export downloaded BUD-PR-FE8DA87E.csv; 'Enter UTR' prompt marked the batch paid (UTR shown in the row, Enter-UTR button gone); month picker 2026-07 + 'Generate commission invoices' created BUD-CI-2026-07-0001/0002 and the PDF button downloaded a .pdf; Scorecards tab renders scores/flags; individual 'Mark paid' on the held vendor surfaced the backend hold error toast. City guides: Mumbai form editor shows guide-intro/when/around/tip + SEO title/description + 4 editable areas, guide-add-venue + guide-venue-name-0.. saved ('Guide saved.'), persisted across reload, 'Edit as JSON' round-trip shows the same data, and the venue rendered on /city/mumbai as city-venues/city-venue-0 with the custom SEO title/description in <title>/meta; 'Reset to default' restored the stock guide and removed the venues section. Vendor portal /vendor/agreement Settlements tab shows 'UTR UTR-TEST-001' under paid rows and the vendor-commission-invoices block with a working vendor-ci-pdf download. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow on the admin payouts panel or /city/mumbai venues (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390). All test data cleaned: TEST_ vendors/settlements/batches/commission invoices deleted, TEST notifications purged, city_guides collection empty, SMOKE Vendor LLP demo data intact (payout_hold false, bank fields, all docs approved, settlements paid with UTR-TEST-001, no TEST_ notes).

minor.issue: totals are always computed over ALL settlements ({}) even when ?status= or ?vendor_id= is supplied, so KPI figures do not match the filtered list.
CSV fields are not quoted/escaped; a beneficiary/legal name containing a comma or quote will shift columns in the bank file.

sequence number = count_documents({period})+1 with no unique index on (period, invoice_no); if an invoice row is ever deleted the next generation reuses a number. Also guarded by agreements:manage rather than a payouts/finance permission.

ui_bugs.issue: A custom guide SEO title gets ' | Buddilio' appended, producing a duplicated brand suffix ('TEST_ Mumbai nights guide | Buddilio | Buddilio'). Use the custom seo_title verbatim.

issues: UTR capture uses window.prompt() instead of a styled modal/shadcn dialog (works, but inconsistent with the rest of the admin UI and unvalidated)
'Run payout batch' always posts due_only:true; there is no UI control to batch not-yet-due settlements even though the API supports it

action_items: OPTIONAL: use the custom guide seo_title as-is on /city/<slug> instead of appending ' | Buddilio' again.
OPTIONAL: scope GET /admin/vendor-settlements totals to the requested status/vendor_id filter.
OPTIONAL: quote CSV fields in the payout export and add a unique index on vendor_commission_invoices.invoice_no.
critical_code_review_comments: vendor_routes.py: commission invoice numbering derives from a count, not a counter/unique index — add a unique index on (invoice_no) and ideally (vendor_id, period) so a deleted row cannot cause a duplicate number.
vendor_routes.py export_payout_run: bank CSV built with raw f-string concatenation; escape/quote the fields before this file is handed to a bank.
vendor_routes.py is 1135 lines; the payout/invoice/scorecard block is a natural candidate to split into its own module (>700-line guideline).
seed_data_creation: Backend suite seeds 'TEST_ Payout Vendor A' (owned by arjun.sethi so vendor-side PDF/list could be tested) + 'TEST_ Held Vendor B' with 3 pending settlements dated 2026-06 and deletes them in fixture teardown. UI testing used tests/i38_seed.py (seed|clean) to create 'TEST_ UI Payable Vendor'/'TEST_ UI Held Vendor' with past-due pending settlements; all removed afterwards. Mumbai city guide edited then reset to default (city_guides collection back to empty).
test_credentials: admin@buddilio.com/Admin@123, partner@buddilio.com/Partner@123, arjun.sethi@example.com/User@123; cron bearer = WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from /app/backend/.env
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression set for build 38: tests/test_iteration35_nav_banking.py, test_iteration35_sitemap_policies.py, test_iteration36_bank_docs_city.py, test_iteration37_doc_review.py, test_iteration38_payouts.py (79 tests, all green). NOTE: test_iteration38_payouts.py deliberately keeps every test in ONE class because pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope — splitting it into multiple classes makes the module-scoped seed fixture run twice on two workers and duplicates vendors/invoice numbers. Use tests/i38_seed.py seed|clean for UI runs. Admin nav testids: vendorpay (Vendor settlements) and guides (City guides). Table testids inside VendorPayouts are settlements-table / batches-table / commission-invoices-table / scorecards-table (NOT invoices-table/scores-table). UTR entry uses window.prompt -> handle with page.once('dialog', ...). Environment restored: only SMOKE Vendor LLP exists, 2 paid settlements with UTR-TEST-001, 1 batch, 1 invoice BUD-CI-2026-08-0001, city_guides empty.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only product-visible nit is the duplicated brand suffix in the city page <title> when a custom guide SEO title is set (Cities.jsx appends ' | Buddilio' unconditionally).
